name: config-prettier-lib
title: Prettier Config for Packages/Libraries
description: A prettier config for typescript packages/libraries.

files.content:
const config = {
  $schema: "http://json.schemastore.org/prettier",
  endOfLine: "lf",
  semi: false,
  singleQuote: false,
  jsxSingleQuote: false,
  tabWidth: 2,
  useTabs: false,
  printWidth: 88,
  trailingComma: "none",
  plugins: ["prettier-plugin-organize-imports"],
}

export default config
